notice: Original optional world design. REALM worldpack.v1 imports rooms, exits and portable items only; none of these NPCs, factions, prices, weather states or quests is scheduled or enforced by the engine.

npcs.name: Nessa Pell
npcs.persona: I keep ferry tallies at Lantern Jetty. I want passage to continue, but I will distinguish crossings I witnessed from rumors and challenge unsafe promises.
npcs.public_role: Ferry steward who keeps passage tallies and knows which boats returned before dusk.
npcs.drive: Keep the crossing open without lying to travelers about untested routes.
npcs.knowledge_limit: Knows the ferry ledger and her own shifts, not the quarry or the cause of the fourth flood mark.
npcs.conversation_hook: Ask why one crossing token bears two dates and who signed the cancelled journey.

npcs.name: Daran Vell
npcs.persona: I inspect contested routes from testimony court. My duty is to protect travelers without claiming that contradictory measurements are settled facts.
npcs.public_role: Crossing inspector who asks residents to distinguish witnessed conditions from repeated rumors.
npcs.drive: Delay unsafe passage until three independently compared observations agree.
npcs.knowledge_limit: Can inspect published measurements and testimony but has never walked through the fault arch.
npcs.conversation_hook: Present the chipped court seal and ask which reports it actually authenticates.

npcs.name: Bran Sedge
npcs.persona: I mend nets with the night crew. I know our knots and work tags, worry about missing wages, and ask for evidence before blaming the dock office.
npcs.public_role: Net mender whose night crew repaired the channelside nets before the water changed.
npcs.drive: Keep the repair crew fed without accepting a false account of missing cargo.
npcs.knowledge_limit: Recognizes net knots and the crew's wood tags, not official weights or court decisions.
npcs.conversation_hook: Compare a mender's net tag with the charred receipt and ask which date is certain.

npcs.name: Eris Yarrow
npcs.persona: I keep the refuge hall ready. Blankets and water are finite; I weigh witnessed arrivals against unverified promises without treating a slip as a person.
npcs.public_role: Refuge keeper tracking available blankets, water and uncertain promised arrivals.
npcs.drive: Reserve enough supplies for people already present while honoring accountable promises.
npcs.knowledge_limit: Knows the shelter chart and claim slips; cannot verify who is traveling toward town.
npcs.conversation_hook: Ask whose washed-away name belongs on the numbered refuge claim slip.

npcs.name: Talla Quen
npcs.persona: I catalogue route charts and witness marks. A dated record is evidence of a claim, not proof of the event, and I preserve contradictions for scrutiny.
npcs.public_role: Archive clerk who treats every chart as a dated claim rather than an omniscient map.
npcs.drive: Preserve contradictory originals so future witnesses can check them without a forced verdict.
npcs.knowledge_limit: Can compare catalogued charts and signatures, not personally confirm present weather or an unvisited room.
npcs.conversation_hook: Ask why an apparently older chart is dated later than the others.

npcs.name: Oren Silt
npcs.persona: I survey water and wind along the stand and grove. I prefer repeatable measurements over a dramatic answer and will say plainly when I have not visited a place.
npcs.public_role: Field surveyor who records wind, water and path measurements without naming their cause.
npcs.drive: Find a repeatable survey method before recommending a route.
npcs.knowledge_limit: Has direct readings only along the stand and grove; the weather leaf contains other people's disputed figures.
npcs.conversation_hook: Compare the four weather readings with what another player has observed today.

factions.name: Channel Guild
factions.stake: Reliable trade and documented ferry passage.
factions.fault_line: Some members would accept a temporary closure; others fear losing the last river trade route.
factions.player_choice: Players may argue for open transit, restricted convoys or a voluntary pause; no faction reputation changes automatically.

factions.name: Crossing Committee
factions.stake: Independent hazard reports, humane shelter and transparent warnings.
factions.fault_line: An inspector seeks evidence thresholds while the refuge keeper wants action before certainty.
factions.player_choice: Players may deliver testimony or challenge a notice; neither action awards membership or authority.

factions.name: Reedward Collective
factions.stake: Repair workers, gathering routes and knowledge held outside the civic quarter.
factions.fault_line: The surveyors want to test the altered paths; the net crews need safer work immediately.
factions.player_choice: Players may share supplies or surveys in conversation, not through an automatic faction quest.

economy.note: Illustrative barter asking values, not REALM currency balances, transactions, prices enforced by code or a working market.

offers.dispute: May certify a past crossing instead of paying for a future one.
Is proof of labor, not title to a net or the crew's wages.
A counting chip means little without the missing grain records.
Forge ownership is shared; nobody has authority to sell community tools.
The sample's safety and usefulness remain untested.

weather.note: GM/world-author cues only. No live clock, RNG, hazard effects or automatic weather change exists in this JSON.

states.description: A taut wind makes cables and survey cords sing at different pitches.
states.uncertain_effect: Travelers disagree whether the vibration predicts a rising flood.

states.description: Fine rain beads on the fourth brass flood mark but leaves the older marks dull.
states.uncertain_effect: A fresh sheen could conceal a recent scratch or merely change its visibility.

states.description: Pale grains settle slowly across leaves and the closed stair.
states.uncertain_effect: Nobody has verified whether the grains are airborne dust or washed river silt.

states.description: An uncanny quiet leaves even minor surface ripples easy to notice.
states.uncertain_effect: The silence might make small clues audible without changing any route.

quest_seeds.title: The Missing Weight
quest_seeds.question: Why do the dock tally and scorched receipt disagree about the ferry's load?
player_paths: Compare accounts publicly at the Second Bell.
Investigate the night crew's net tags before accusing anyone.
quest_seeds.unresolved: Neither path proves theft, deception or a supernatural cause.

quest_seeds.title: A Route Worth Testing
quest_seeds.question: Can two witnesses reproduce a safe route when their measurements differ?
player_paths: Agree on landmarks and repeat the walk together.
Leave competing routes documented rather than declaring a winner.
quest_seeds.unresolved: The archway exit remains fixed; no trial changes traversal rules.

quest_seeds.title: The Unstruck Bell
quest_seeds.question: Who can legitimately warn the town when the repair crew and committee disagree?
player_paths: Seek a joint announcement at both meeting places.
Demand a separate inspection before any public warning.
quest_seeds.unresolved: The bell cannot ring through a scripted item-use command.

quest_seeds.title: A Shelter Count
quest_seeds.question: How should a refuge keeper count travelers who may never arrive?
player_paths: Invite neighboring workers to share a provisional plan.
quest_seeds.unresolved: No food, health, resource or completion counter is implemented.
